elements.quote: The overt DIC scoring system was developed based on the previous scoring criteria called Japanese Ministry Health and Welfare (JMHW) DIC criteria... The reported drawback of ISTH overt DIC criteria is a delay in diagnostic timing... The other commonly used diagnostic criteria is the Japanese association for acute medicine-DIC (JAAM-DIC) criteria... However, the SIRS category that makes up the JAAM DIC criteria is no longer used in the sepsis-3 definition, necessitating other criteria which best fit with the new definition. Anationwide retrospective survey in Japan produced new diagnostic criteria for sepsisinduced coagulopathy (SIC)... Previous studies have examined the diagnostic and prognostic performance of the aforementioned scoring systems in sepsis patients. The proportion of DIC in sepsis when applying ISTH-DIC criteria ranged from 16% to 45%... while the proportion based on JAAM-- DIC criteria ranged from 29% to 91%... Based on the SIC criteria, the proportion of coagulopathy in sepsis patients ranged from 22% to 86%... Similar variability in mortality rate and predictive performance of outcomes have been observed.
elements.reason: The text describes the current state of knowledge regarding DIC diagnostic criteria (ISTH-DIC, JAAM-DIC, SIC), their limitations, and the variability in reported outcomes in existing studies.

elements.quote: However, pooled estimate of the proportion of positive scores, mortality rate, and predictive performance of these scores, by making use of meta-analysis in sepsis patients is lacking. This systematic review and metaanalysis assessed the proportion of DIC and coagulopathy in sepsis patients based on the ISTH-DIC, JAAM-DIC, and SIC criteria and evaluated their performance in predicting mortality in sepsis patients.
